{"message": "Fixed the stack-full check in `z_impl_k_stack_push` (`/zephyrproject/zephyr/kernel/stack.c`).

### Cause
`stack->top` is initialized to `stack->base + num_entries` (one past the end of the stack buffer). In `z_impl_k_stack_push`, the check `CHECKIF(stack->next > stack->top)` allowed pushing one extra item past the end of the buffer when `stack->next == stack->top` instead of returning `-ENOMEM`.

### Fix
Changed the condition in `z_impl_k_stack_push` from `CHECKIF(stack->next > stack->top)` to `CHECKIF(stack->next == stack->top)`.

### Verification
Built and ran `tests/kernel/stack/stack` on `qemu_riscv32`; all test suites passed (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`).", "kind": "FinishAction"}

{"content": [{"cache_prompt": false, "type": "text", "text": "Fixed the stack-full check in `z_impl_k_stack_push` (`/zephyrproject/zephyr/kernel/stack.c`).

### Cause
`stack->top` is initialized to `stack->base + num_entries` (one past the end of the stack buffer). In `z_impl_k_stack_push`, the check `CHECKIF(stack->next > stack->top)` allowed pushing one extra item past the end of the buffer when `stack->next == stack->top` instead of returning `-ENOMEM`.

### Fix
Changed the condition in `z_impl_k_stack_push` from `CHECKIF(stack->next > stack->top)` to `CHECKIF(stack->next == stack->top)`.

### Verification
Built and ran `tests/kernel/stack/stack` on `qemu_riscv32`; all test suites passed (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`)."}], "is_error": false, "kind": "FinishObservation"}
